A 29 year old man was talking to his 84-year-old friend about how much politics has changed in just the last few decades. Though the 84-year-old complained about how things were much better way back before all these changes, the 29 year old took a much more optimistic view and was overall happy with the politics of today. Who is resistant to change?
A. The 84-year-old
B. The 29 year old
C. Not known
